title: I Had No Idea I Was Featured On The Internet
subtitle: This is a total lie
text: The Frontier Psychiatrists is a daily enough newsletter. It's health themed. It was started, in part, because I've been harassed for years, by someone who accused me of being rapist and a puppy murderer. I wanted to have some content that wasn't about “Owen murdering puppies” out there, and so this newsletter? It is one of the ways I have attempted …
